sources.entry: LokalBot - On-device meeting notes, dictation, inline autocomplete, and searchable work memory for macOS. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/stevyhacker/lokalbot) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: LokalBot
summary.one_liner: LokalBot is a free, open-source personal context engine that records and searches your meetings and, if you opt in, on-screen activity, running locally by default.
keywords: remember what i saw on screen
use_cases: Transcribing and summarizing meetings on your own machine
Searching past meetings and on-screen activity
Dictating text locally on a Mac
Chatting with summaries using a local model, Ollama, or your ChatGPT/Claude plan
Recording meetings without a bot joining the call
summary.what_it_does: LokalBot records the microphone and meeting audio on separate tracks, transcribes them, and writes meeting notes in the meeting's language. It can save activity-only tracking, visible screen text, or encrypted screenshots, with excluded apps and password fields skipped. Captured text and screenshots are deleted after 14 days by default, while explicitly saved moments are kept until removed. Models are configurable: built-in local models, a downloaded model, Ollama, an OpenAI-compatible server, Apple Intelligence on Mac, or a ChatGPT or Claude plan without an API key. Transcription covers 52 languages with the default Qwen3-ASR model.
notable: Free and open source under GPLv3 with no account, subscription, or LokalBot server
No bot joins meetings; records microphone and meeting audio on separate tracks
Screen capture is opt-in, with activity-only tracking as the default for new installs
Model choice: local models, Ollama, OpenAI-compatible servers, Apple Intelligence, or existing ChatGPT/Claude plans
caveats: Requires Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or later) with macOS 15 or later; Intel Macs are not supported
Windows 10/11 (x64) and 64-bit Linux support is in alpha, and some features are Mac only
Remote models and connected agent or CLI/MCP tools receive context or access the network under their own data handling once approved
